The company offers beautifully furnished and thoughtfully equipped apartments for a month, a year, or even longer that are designed to help people simply show up and start living. Blueground plans to have a presence in 50 cities around the world and a portfolio of more than 50,000 apartments. ‍

description: InstaShop is an online grocery shopping marketplace with a focus on making groceries easier for the everyday life of a consumer. The company enables users to shop at local supermarkets directly from mobile or computer and receive orders at home within minutes or at a scheduled time. The world’s first sharing economy left luggage service. MoneyHash is MEA's first Super API for payment orchestration and revenue automation. It is focused on mid to high value rental properties in London and charge a fixed, success based fee of £948+VAT, the lowest in the market. Their comprehensive lettings service is simple, fair and transparent, and is underpinned by market-leading technology developed in-house. They also invest heavily in data analytics and this, combined with various proprietary property marketing tools, allows them to achieve a 8% – 10% higher rental yield for their customers compared to other estate agencies. ‍

Project Agora is helping top local publishers simplify and take the maximum out of their ad-inventory monetization, so they can fuel their investment in local content and services. Project Agora is currently working with hundreds of major websites in Central East Europe, South East Europe, Middle East, and North Africa algorithmically matching their 1bn+ advertising impressions with thousands of local and international advertisers. For advertisers, Project Agora provides the most impactful ad-formats and sharply defined audiences at highly viewable inventory coming from the top publishers in the countries we operate.

ContactPigeon is a SaaS (Software as a Service) platform that gives a solution to every retailer’s problem: How to send the right message, at the right time, with the right content to each visitor. It enables one-person-shops and enterprise retailers alike to benefit from the use of a Big Data platform, in order to easily create data-driven Automations and Personalized Campaigns that react to customer/visitor behaviors and catalog changes in seconds. Thus, the recipient is guided to place an order (or complete another goal), while at the same time is shielded from unwanted messages.

Viral Loops is an all-in-one viral and referral marketing platform helping companies leverage word of mouth sales from their existing customers or users. It allows people to build pre-launch campaigns, sweepstakes, and competitions, as well as referral programs, which can be integrated in their website or mobile app in minutes. Companies like AirBnB and Dropbox leverage this marketing channel for increasing their customer base with an affordable, yet effective way. ‍

With an innovative hardware device and an easy to use platform, BibeCoffee comes to streamline the way Coffee Distributors, Makers, and Chains work and operate; guaranteeing that high-quality coffee is always served without compromises.
tagline: BibeCoffee transforms any coffee machine into a smart device with real-time data insights.

description: Alvar Pet's mission is to minimize the carbon pawprint of dogs. It offers personalized meal plans based on the dog's individual needs, formulate recipes using sustainable ingredients and minimize the environmental burden across the value chain. Its CO2e pawprint is 84% lower compared to other premium dog food brands. Through a direct-to-dog subscription model, Alvar serves customers in Finland and Germany.

Mediately helps doctors make better decisions by making medical knowledge accessible. The company takes complex medical content, organizes, simplifies and localizes it for each market and makes it available for free to doctors in a mobile app in their language. Their app helps doctors treat better, diagnose faster and learn more. On the business side, the company's wide reach enables the pharmaceutical industry to inform doctors about new therapies and clinical research, and to learn from them about their clinical challenges through market research.

MyJobNow enables thousands of blue-collar workers to find easily the job they are looking for. Through its easy-to-use App it allows job-seekers to create their professional profile, navigate through job opportunities in their area and connect with the employer in seconds. On the other side, the app creates a targeted way for employers to review, assess, book interviews, and hire their applicants.

Advantis Medical Imaging provides advanced web based software solutions in the field of MR Imaging. More specifically, Advantis offers a highly sophisticated, web based and user friendly post processing and 3D visualisation software suite named “Brainance”, for the processing of three different brain MRI exams: Diffusion, Perfusion and Functional MRI. Brainance: Uses the in-house developed algorithms which achieve, in the case of DTI, extremely high accuracy rates (90% vs 65% achieved by traditional algorithms) in the final 3D reconstruction of the human brain’s nerve fibers. Thus, it consists a better tool to diagnose more timely and accurately severe chronic diseases towards the improvement of the patient’s quality of life. In contrast to traditional desktop software applications, Brainance is accessible from an internet browser and there are no device restrictions. Just upload the exams you want to process to your account and start processing instantly.

RTsafe produces PseudoPatient™ dosimetry phantoms, built from real patient anatomical data, by combining proven expertise in medical physics with highly accurate 3D printing technology. Point, 2D or 3D dosimetry can be implemented using these dosimetry phantoms. Planning CT scanning, Treatment Planning, Set-up/Immobilization, Image Guidance and Treatment delivery are applied to the RTsafe PseudoPatient™ phantoms as if they are real living patients. This approach results in a true End-to-End QA testing that incorporates all links of the treatment chain. RTsafe enables an accurate, individualized radiotherapy treatment for each patient suffering from brain cancer. As a result, this reduces risk of collateral damage during treatment and enhances treatment efficiency. ‍

Blendo is a self-serve data integration platform that allows you to collect and sync your data with any data warehouse. Blendo allows companies to remix data from multiple sources - from simple csv files to data coming from your internal databases, your favorite CRM, email campaigns, analytics and more - into business value. Now you can control your data.
tagline: Connect with any data warehouse (acquired by Rudderstack)

description: Byrd is a tech-driven third-party logistics and fulfillment company on a mission to revolutionise the logistics industry. This helps businesses to meet and exceed the expectations of their customers with regard to shipping, therefore ensuring customer satisfaction. Their ambition is to bring a small revolution in the local multi-million promotions industry and a big one in the global multi-billion promotions industry! ‍
